reasons.settings.env.ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL: Run Claude Code's helper calls (page summaries, web search, titles) on Haiku 5.5, named by full model id whatever a gateway's alias table says.
reasons.settings.env.CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WI: Set the auto-compact window the compaction plugin reads.
reasons.settings.env.CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION: Enable function hooks for pfm's Claude plugins.
reasons.settings.env.CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SP: Lift the agent nesting limit from Claude Code's 3, too shallow for agents that spawn agents.
reasons.settings.env.CLAUDE_CODE_NATIVE_CURSOR: Blink the terminal's own cursor at the prompt, so the cursor style a user sets in the terminal shows instead of the one Claude Code draws.
reasons.settings.tui: Run Claude Code's fullscreen renderer; a seat carrying it also gets CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER (noFlicker), and "tui": "default" or null in claude.settings turns it off.
reasons.registry.leftArrowOpensAgents: Keep ← on an empty prompt from opening the agents view.
